name: Kousaka Takahiko
source:
Kinpou Institutute Senior High School Chemistry teacher.
Star Sign: Libra
He has a soft demeanor, but because he has a lot of pride in his teaching profession he is strict about the rules.
Some students carefully consider him disagreeable, but he is quite reliable to  those who follow his standards.
He makes decisions with a level head, but from time to time he gives strange answers to things.
